title: Photo Duo 074 · 아워글래스 USSBBW × 콜로설 · 둘 다 걸터앉기
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A photograph of TWO women seated side by side on one short backless bench carved from a solid block of pale grey stone, just long enough for the two of them and no longer, in a bare gallery space with a plain smooth deep-charcoal wall behind them, the camera set close at bench level so the two of them fill the frame edge to edge, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subjects: TWO real adult women, both far beyond any real person in size, seated with their knees apart and their feet flat on the floor, their two bodies together overflowing the stone on both sides and filling the frame from edge to edge, their hips and sides pressed against each other and the flesh bulging out where they touch.

Left woman: a Latina woman in her late 40s, warm golden-tan skin with olive undertones, her face exactly the same tone as her body, a short cropped pixie cut. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — the one place on her body where the outline pulls inward. Below it an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and settles down over her thighs as she sits, spreading forward and outward under its own weight in three or four heavy rounded folds with deep creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, merging seamlessly into her sides, hips and thighs with no boundary anywhere, not pregnant. Colossal hips more than three times the width of that waistline and a gigantic rear, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist. Her hips spread wide and flatten against the seat, the flesh of her thighs bulging out above and below where the hard front edge presses into them. Painted in Thai lai rot nam — brilliant gold leaf over black lacquer, continuous kranok flame scrolls covering every surface, a gold border band following every curve.

Right woman: an East African woman in her late 20s, deep umber skin with a warm sheen, her face exactly the same tone as her body, a high ponytail tied with a cord. A giantess built on a completely even scale, every part enlarged by the same amount: massive rounded shoulders, huge thick arms, a colossal full bust, a broad heavy torso with a large smooth rounded belly, wide solid hips, enormous columnar thighs. Her shoulders span more than four head-widths and each hand is as wide as a normal woman's torso. No single part stands out more than another, no hanging folds, not pregnant. Her hips spread wide and flatten against the seat, the flesh of her thighs bulging out above and below where the hard front edge presses into them. Painted in Italian maiolica tin-glaze — a warm cream glaze painted with cobalt, ochre, copper green and manganese purple scrolls and medallions, a bold cobalt band following every curve.

Their outer hands rest on the stone beside their hips, their inner hands on their own thighs. On both: real photographic skin with visible pores, creases where the flesh folds and faint stretch marks, no illustration finish, no CG sheen. The paint is pigment on living skin, distorting over every bulge and cracking where it folds, covering everything below the jaw with no bare skin left; their faces unpainted, the pattern fading out at the neck. Neither arm crosses in front of her own body or the other woman's, both faces toward the camera. Every fold keeps its own rounded outline with a deep crease between them, never one shapeless mass; arms, hands and legs in correct proportion. Both wear extreme platform stiletto heels with soles as tall as their ankle bones.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation photograph, taller than it is wide.
